meta.title: A lot-level RFP closes when every active response has a score; with both modes on, the lines must be scored too
gaps: No setup recipe creates an RFP lot with three responses, including one withdrawn response, or a second RFP with both lot- and line-level scoring modes.
No operation or library case can submit lot-level or line-level evaluation scores and verify the resulting round closure state.
The required checks for active-response counting, line and event "has evaluations" markers, and the intermediate open/closed states are not expressible.
